task.problem: BP-V4 requires measured bounded parallel full-suite conformance and verification-cost observability before any fixed parallel profile can be adopted. The repository currently has no declared pytest-xdist capability and verification_contract.py intentionally recognizes only a narrow pytest grammar. Treating a wrapper that internally runs several full suites as an opaque command would bypass BP-V1 full-suite justification and subsumption rules, while putting worker selection or scheduling into Runtime would create the wrong authority. TASK-157 must therefore establish a narrow measurement contract and structured probe that Runtime can invoke later as one authorized verification command. The probe must expose correctness, collection identity, worker-isolation facts, toolchain identity, and timing without selecting a winner or turning performance into semantic completion authority. Real full-suite parallel measurement and worker selection belong to later BP-V4 lineage.
